patch.value: Refuse unsafe diagnostic and artifact inputs before reading
Reject non-regular and oversized package inputs with bounded reads and typed remedies; include plan input and scope resolution in the execution deadline.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Auditing every direct package reader. Use one bounded regular-file reader with nonblocking open and descriptor validation, preserve domain refusal categories and remedies, charge diagnostic input and scope resolution to the shared deadline. Regressions use real special files and externally bounded subprocesses in a non-Git fixture.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented one regular-file input primitive across all direct readers, including backend config, policy, evidence versions, workflow files, source scanners, coverage artifacts and plan JSON. Real FIFO without a writer, Unix socket, device, directory and oversized inputs return typed remedies; descriptor race and growth controls pass. Non-Git tracker and empty PATH exercise eight input surfaces. Local reader suites: 130 passed, zero failed/skipped.
